name: Pandagraph
source:
"All you need is to be ready, and the mental fortitude to deal with having your body completely broken into smithereens."

A dentist.
Depending on the pay, she'll do any procedure. 
Because of her illegal procedures she's being chased across the galaxy. She's currently continuing her work in secret on earth.
